name: Velvet Antenna v0.20.4 Standalone
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna release. v0.20.4 fixes duplicate filtering so unresolved cards cannot leak into duplicate results, requires corroborating title evidence for provider-ID matches, and retains Needs ID, native multi-select, playback, Series/Season and metadata-management functionality.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.21.5 Velvet Lens
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna redesign focused on speed and a distinct browsing identity. v0.21.5 restores Jellyfin's native right-click and multi-select administration by keeping context-menu handling untouched and raising the native selection command bar above Velvet Antenna navigation, while retaining inline IDENTIFY, duplicate resolution badges and DELETE, native Series/Season functionality, subtitles and detail PLAY/CONTINUE.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.4 Antenna Flow
author: James
description: Stability reset for Antenna Flow. v0.22.4 stops layering competing v0.21/v0.22 presentation controllers over the same UI. A single v0.22.4 shell now owns Home, Movies, Series, Collections and Tonight; the old v0.21 nav, hero and library stage are hidden and retained only for proven playback/native behaviour. Collections prefers Jellyfin's own native My Media card route instead of forcing Box Sets, Live is deliberately removed until it has a proven route, Home is owned from first paint by a fast Antenna Flow surface, Tonight opens immediately and uses a small candidate dataset instead of a heavy whole-library scan, Movies/Series/Collections use a separate deterministic Velvet Lens stage, and CC+ subtitle search remains included.
